## Context

`no_file_impact_reason` is operator-authored free text in the signed plan-review material. The original whitespace-normalization epic established that insignificant whitespace must not stale attestations while substantive edits must. Runtime proof shows `material_basis()` still hashes this reason raw, so boundary whitespace produces `stale-material`.

Compatibility spans three historical fingerprint generations: pre-330c raw description/raw reason; post-330c pre-2be7 checkbox-normalized/raw reason; and post-2be7 pre-this-fix whitespace-normalized description/raw reason.

## Plan

- Add a held-out in-process RED oracle through the real material fingerprint and attestation-validity seams.
- Normalize insignificant reason whitespace in the current material basis using the established canonicalizer.
- Extend legacy validity recomputation so unchanged attestations from all three historical generations remain valid, while invalid hashes and meaningful reason edits remain stale.
- Run the focused plan-review suites, mutation-check the exact raw-reason defect, then run lint, typecheck, and the broader unit gate.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Boundary/trailing whitespace-only variants of `no_file_impact_reason` produce the same current material fingerprint and a signed review remains `certified`.
- [ ] Interior whitespace or a word change remains material and yields `stale-material`.
- [ ] Pre-330c and post-330c/pre-2be7 legacy recomputations continue hashing the reason raw.
- [ ] Post-2be7/pre-fix attestations with canonical descriptions and raw reasons are explicitly grandfathered.
- [ ] A valid-looking unrelated fingerprint remains stale, and existing legacy/description-normalization tests pass unchanged.

## Verification

Focused pytest nodes cover fingerprint equality, exact validity status, negative controls, and all legacy generations. The final change also passes repository lint, typecheck, and unit-test gates.
